digest.component_or_area: tickets branch rewrite and garbage collection
propositions: Execute a one-time tickets branch rewrite under full quiescence with all writes disabled, all sessions stopped, and all MCP servers halted, guarded by operator attestation and epoch-mismatch refusal proofs.

Disable GitHub workflows (reconcile-bridge.yml and reconcile-bridge-canary.yml), pause AWS timers and LaunchAgents, pause review-bot and Gerrit queue activity, and verify no in-flight reconciliation or pending votes before beginning any destructive operation.

Strip and rewrite the tickets branch with git-filter-repo to reclaim 92% of repository size (from 1.04 GiB to ~94 MiB), verified pre-publication against a fresh unfiltered clone with identical tree and commit/merge counts.

Record pre-rewrite identity summary and post-rewrite mapped enforce_since value, land the identity.enforce_since re-pin through Gerrit, and verify the first post-window write is atomic with no old-tip resurrection or size explosion.

After all writers quiesce and publication succeeds, re-enable workflows and timers, run post-window reconciliation, and verify repository cleanliness with zero repairable fsck diagnostics and exactly four intentional STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED audit records.

Validate that the default-clone federation excludes the old tip as unreachable, size-pack growth after first post-window write is below 1 MiB, and old ancestry checks return false on all accessible refs.
